import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.lib.weights.weights import WeightLambda
from pocket_coffea.lib.weights.common.common import common_weights


def _toy_reweight_func(params, metadata, events, size, shape_variations):
    """Nominal weight from LHEWeight_originalXWGTUP, normalized to 1, +/-5% variations."""
    raw = events.LHEWeight_originalXWGTUP
    nominal = raw / ak.mean(raw)
    up = nominal * 1.05
    down = nominal * 0.95

    function=_toy_reweight_func,
    has_variations=True,
)
